changed_files: module.py if any node is changed, otherwise empty
changed_sets: All subsets of nodes in each graph, including the empty set
limitations: Finite domains, not proof for arbitrary graph sizes
Graph edges are supplied directly; parser completeness is not tested
Only impacted() is tested; other conservative selection fallbacks are out of scope
Cases are exhaustive states, not independent research observations
negative_control: Reverse production edge direction on a single one-way edge and require disagreement with the oracle
node_layout: First node is module.py file node; remaining nodes are named functions in module.py
oracle: All-pairs shortest directed path distances using Floyd-Warshall; consumer is impacted if its distance to any changed seed is at most depth. Seeds include the changed file node.
scope: Development verification of impacted(), not empirical claim truth or parser completeness
